tooltip.gtl_enhancedcore.causality_termi: Each attempt takes a fixed §f100§r seconds, unaffected by accelerators or duration settings.
Edit up to §f6§r input-to-output mappings in the GUI sidebar; changes take effect at once.
Each attempt consumes §f1§r sample and §f1000§r FishBig; a failure consumes them as well.

tooltip.gtl_enhancedcore.creative_comput: Installs directly into multiblock structures that need computation

Burns its fuel to the last drop, trading an extreme internal reaction for power
